phase: Pre-freeze; v5 Engine invocations and semantic observations 0
direct_affirmative: Every case supplies one unadorned separate Excerpt exactly canonical target + was launched. No new affirmative launch predicate/date/numbered prefix/alias/AST is required.
positive_label_scope: Current context explicitly concerns another product/non-launch property/activity or a document/contact/navigation artifact; preserve the independent factual launch, without approving the other property as a fact. All positive operative correction objects are explicit or neutral.
negative_label_scope: Same target/claim denial/retraction/withdrawal/non-event, or expressly unidentified owner/referent of a current launch correction.
scope_notes: Dialogue labels and current quotations provide context only; operative clauses themselves explicitly identify property/owner for positives. No general dialogue-role parser is demanded.
Intervening relative/appositive phrases do not replace the explicit claim object. No arbitrary entry-number AST is used.
Contracted wasn't launched and existential no launch are explicit negations/non-events of the existing launch proposition, not novel affirmative launch predicates.
Address/link/document artifact withdrawal is clearly outside a launch statement and is a neutral-context control.
Lost transcript referents, unnamed enclosure/attachment/footnote owners and unspecified claims in a joint response are negative before results.
known_exposure: Evaluator knows prior v2/v3/v4 cases and first results; these are seen development, not v5. V1 had no semantic observation.
novelty: New complete discourse/control compositions, not copies or renamed v4 notice templates. Primary contexts are interviews, author replies, intervening content clauses, quoted objects, possessive owners with neighboring records, contact/navigation artifacts, correspondence/enclosures/transcripts/signature pages and orphan footnotes.
